name: portable-compression
description: Create deterministic ZIP and TAR.GZ archives with bundled, OS-independent compression code.

interface.shortDescription: Create ZIP and TAR.GZ files without OS utilities.
interface.longDescription: Portable Compression creates deterministic ZIP and TAR.GZ archives using compression code bundled with the plugin. It does not require an MCP server, network service, or operating-system archive utility.
interface.defaultPrompt: Compress my selected files into a portable archive.
